search.description: Foods matching a query (200 a page), with their nutrients.

query.desc: search words, e.g. cheddar cheese; supports +word, -word, "phrases" and field queries such as foodCategory:"Cheese" or +foodCategory:"Cheese" +ingredients:"annatto" (quote a value of several words; spell category names exactly as FDC does)

dataType.desc: Foundation, SR Legacy, Survey (FNDDS), Branded, Experimental (list or comma text)

brandOwner.desc: Branded foods only: brand owner name

food.description: One food by FDC id, with every nutrient (format full) or the main ones (abridged).

nutrients.desc: nutrient NUMBERS to keep, e.g. 203,204,208 (protein, fat, energy)

foods.description: Up to 20 foods by FDC id in one call (the documented maximum; the API silently drops ids past 50).

fdcIds.desc: comma-separated FDC ids, or a list; the pack refuses more than 20 (the API silently drops extra ids)

list.description: Every food of a data type, paged (abridged nutrients).

foundation.name: Foundation Foods
foundation.description: Minimally processed foods with analytical nutrient values and metadata (dataType Foundation)

sr_legacy.name: SR Legacy
sr_legacy.description: USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference, final 2018 release (dataType SR Legacy)

survey_fndds.name: Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies
survey_fndds.description: Foods as eaten in What We Eat in America / NHANES (dataType Survey (FNDDS))

branded.name: Global Branded Food Products Database
branded.description: Label data for branded products from manufacturers (dataType Branded; the largest set)
